claim: October 16, 2026 primary court orders establish distinct responses to an existing BNC service interruption. Indiana permits a party seeking relief to elect certain court notices at that party's own expense with a certificate of service; it also requires adjournment of improperly noticed creditor meetings. Northern Illinois authorizes judge-directed deadline and hearing relief. The orders and official FAQs do not prove case-level delivery, practical ability to pay, or completed downstream consequence repair.
falsifier: Case-level records demonstrating timely, legally sufficient notice and available effective remedy would defeat a claim of failed contestability in those particular proceedings. A later contrary or amended court order would revise the procedural account. Such case-specific evidence does not negate the documented BNC interruption.
